response: An invasive strategy based on bronchoscopy to diagnose nosocomial pneumonia, also known as ventilator-associated pneumonia (VAP), does not delay treatment when the clinical suspicion of VAP occurs during off-hours. In fact, studies have shown that this approach is not associated with a longer time to first appropriate antibiotic administration, even when the diagnosis is made outside of regular working hours. Therefore, invasive diagnosis of nosocomial pneumonia during off-hours does not delay treatment.
